v1.bytes:
schema_version: 1
version: us-sec-long-v1
enabled_scoring_versions:
  - us-price-baseline-v2
price_provider: twelve_data
fundamentals_provider: sec
return_basis: split_adjusted_price_return
dividends_included: false
probability_positive_enabled: false
eligibility:
  maximum_metric_age_days: 200
  minimum_share_consistency_periods: 3
  share_consistency_relative_tolerance: 0.15
  balance_sheet_date_tolerance_days: 7
  fcf_failure_blocks_eps: true
  unsupported_sic_ranges:
    - 6000-6799
metric_families:
  fcf_per_share:
    source_metric: free_cash_flow
    minimum_annual_periods: 3
    minimum_current_value: 0.01
    multiple_minimum: 3.0
    multiple_maximum: 60.0
  eps_per_share:
    source_metric: net_income
    minimum_annual_periods: 3
    minimum_current_value: 0.01
    multiple_minimum: 5.0
    multiple_maximum: 50.0
growth:
  historical_recency_decay: 0.65
  historical_minimum: -0.20
  historical_maximum: 0.25
  tax_rate_minimum: 0.10
  tax_rate_maximum: 0.35
  roic_minimum: -0.10
  roic_maximum: 0.40
  reinvestment_minimum: 0.00
  reinvestment_maximum: 1.25
  sustainable_minimum: -0.10
  sustainable_maximum: 0.25
  peer_minimum: -0.15
  peer_maximum: 0.25
  historical_weight: 0.45
  sustainable_weight: 0.30
  peer_weight: 0.25
  initial_growth_minimum: -0.15
  initial_growth_maximum: 0.25
  terminal_growth: 0.025
peer:
  sic_prefix_levels: [4, 3, 2]
  minimum_peers:
    4: 3
    3: 5
    2: 8
horizons:
  3y:
    years: 3
    fade: [0.70, 0.40, 0.15]
    multiple_reversion: 0.45
  5y:
    years: 5
    fade: [0.80, 0.60, 0.40, 0.20, 0.00]
    multiple_reversion: 0.70
scenarios:
  bear:
    growth_delta: -0.04
    reinvestment_multiplier: 0.75
    peer_multiple_multiplier: 0.80
  base:
    growth_delta: 0.00
    reinvestment_multiplier: 1.00
    peer_multiple_multiplier: 1.00
  bull:
    growth_delta: 0.03
    reinvestment_multiplier: 1.15
    peer_multiple_multiplier: 1.15
